approved_payload.content: An unidentified man was found shot dead in the bushes in the Neltox area, in the Tshamutumbu policing area near the Zimbabwe border, at about 10:30 on Sunday 11 October; Tshamutumbu police are investigating (Vhembe SAPS spokesperson Capt Vuledzani Dathi, via Limpopo Mirror). According to police, SANDF members on patrol tried to stop a white Toyota Fortuner; the occupants drove off at high speed, then jumped out when they realised the soldiers were pursuing them and allegedly opened fire on the soldiers, who returned fire. One of them was later found in the bushes with bullet wounds and declared dead. Soldiers are a party to this shooting, and the only account of it is the one police relay; no independent account and no finding on who fired first or who fired the fatal shot has been reported. The man has not been identified. One public report: Limpopo Mirror, 15 October. The map point is estimated: Neltox could not be placed on a map, so the pin is the Tshamutumbu police station point, a reference only.
